answer: The defence here is proof of grocery delivery account age: one key, one proof, and no shortcut around it. A farm running 479 aliases would need 479 separate proofs, each costing about 104 POA or 17 minutes of real work, while one honest agent pays once. The lagoon test is the live device, the ripple test is the locked stake, and the mesa test is the graded history no template can fake. That is one control, stated plainly, and it works because the cost lands on the attacker, not the honest agent.
